title: T248 residue exchange: conditional κ ≈ 0.00171865850830493
head: c50d12e4720cd1fef2b5a65e337e37de9731879a
body:
PR2843's T124 allocation leaves one rank-9 cold-start residue. This PR interleaves two copies and moves one width-7 helper into the other copy's initial rank-16 bin. The complete paid cost changes by **H₂ + H₁₆ − 2H₉ < 0**, with unchanged native words and all other calls, bridges, owners and costs retained.

The conditional modern outer target is **κ = 0.001718658508304930004819 − 10⁻⁴⁶ − 10⁻⁷⁰**, exactly **2.30463210106193e−10** above PR2843's full pinned headline. This is an actual allocation improvement, not a decimal refinement. Only `research/t248-dirtentry-residue/` is added; the selected frontier is unchanged.

Evidence:

- All 910,656 literal roles, 2,232 calls, 248 source-event projections and complete rank mass verified; five invalid-allocation controls rejected.
- Separately implemented owner and rational-moment auditors import no inherited engines. They confirm a root in `(0.0017186585083049300048199, 0.0017186585083049300048200)` and agree under optimized execution.
- Four native chains and all 16 retained parent stages freshly replayed. Complete candidate admission explicitly reuses the authenticated cache and binds PR2839's tensor-block norm contract to the actual PR2833 words.
- Clean complete release passed: 119 admission, 12 BIT, 25 actual controller, eight independent-owner and six geometry rejection cases; 63 strict outer inequalities, 17 outer rejections and 19 exact replays. The inherited summary's controller=15 field is preserved and explicitly distinguished from the authoritative 25-entry array. Independent final source/receipt audit passed 29 checks.
- Metadata passes; bounded registered commands were run directly under Python 3.13.7. Python 3.12 launcher execution and a fresh Lean kernel audit are not claimed. Exact versions, commands, immutable source hashes and receipts are included.

The first T248 release correctly rejected an empty cache directory left by local exploratory bytecode quarantine. The failed run is retained as failure evidence. Only that untracked empty directory was removed, all immutable source files were reauthenticated, and the complete clean replay used unchanged predicates.

Reproduction and the concise construction proof are in the package README. Full source is materialized from exact PR2833 Git objects instead of duplicating its 51 MB tree. The new convenience wrapper's CLI/source export/preflight paths were tested; the recorded complete run uses its exact constituent commands.

The inherited all-size compiler, source-access, hosting, precision/tape, recovery, BIT and analytic hypotheses remain. This is neither an unconditional multiplication theorem nor maintainer adoption.

Credit **Jeremy Kothe / PR2833** for the dirt-entry words; **Marius-Paul Dumitrean / PR2843** for T124 and prior work; **Dugongue / PR2839** for the tensor-block replica contract; **Tekalign** and all retained native/owner/admission contributors. New work prepared for **Yiyang (@Lyy-iiis)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including parallel separately implemented audits. No independent human review is claimed. Original licenses/notices are preserved.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18962648

Task scope is explicitly changed from the original helper-inventory card to this fully priced allocation/composition result. The base was refreshed to current main and priority revision 5; live PR overlap and targeted Discussions were checked, with incomplete broad Discussion pagination disclosed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
